name_zh: 克拉夫丘克/尤先科/泽连斯基：后苏联转型治理与抗争民主
name_en: Kravchuk/Yushchenko/Zelenskyy: Post-Soviet Transition Governance & Resistance Democracy
description_zh: 乌克兰三代后苏联领袖跨越三十年共同完成：列昂尼德·克拉夫丘克 (1934-2022) 首任总统 (1991-1994) 签署别洛韦日协议解体苏联、确立主权；维克托·尤先科 (1954-) 橙色革命 (2004) 胜选、推行去共化/北约/欧盟路线；弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基 (1978-) 2019 大选压倒性胜利、2022 抗俄战争战时领袖、数字化治理/反腐/全球外交动员。三人共同体现 M161 后苏联转型治理——以"主权确立+民主巩固+抗争生存"三阶段，在俄/西/内部寡头三重压力下重构国家主体性。
description_en: Three generations of Ukrainian post-Soviet leaders across three decades: Leonid Kravchuk (1934-2022) 1st President (1991-1994) signed Belovezha Accords dissolving USSR, established sovereignty; Viktor Yushchenko (1954-) Orange Revolution (2004) victory, drove decommunization/NATO/EU path; Volodymyr Zelenskyy (1978-) 2019 landslide election, 2022 wartime leader against Russian invasion, digital governance/anti-corruption/global diplomatic mobilization. Together exemplify M161 Post-Soviet Transition Governance—three phases of 'sovereignty establishment + democratic consolidation + resistance survival' reconstructing national subjectivity under triple pressure of Russia/West/oligarchs.
reason_zh: 乌克兰后苏联转型是"主权-民主-生存"三重螺旋上升：克拉夫丘克确立主权合法性，尤先科以橙色革命锚定民主方向，泽连斯基以抗争战争升华为生存民主。M161 区隔于 M170 后苏联威权稳定(白俄罗斯)、M181 边境地带共同体(历史)、M163 斯拉夫边境生存(地缘)，核心在于"主权确立->民主巩固->抗争生存"的三阶段螺旋上升。
reason_en: Ukraine's post-Soviet transition is triple helix of 'sovereignty-democracy-survival': Kravchuk established sovereign legitimacy, Yushchenko anchored democratic direction via Orange Revolution, Zelenskyy elevated resistance war to survival democracy. M161 distinct from M170 Post-Soviet Authoritarian Stability (Belarus), M181 Borderland Commonwealth (historical), M163 Slavic Borderland Survival (geopolitical), core: 'sovereignty establishment -> democratic consolidation -> resistance survival' three-phase spiral ascent.
steps_zh: 主权合法性确立：1991 别洛韦日协议/12 月 1 日全民公投 90%+ 支持独立，克拉夫丘克签署解体苏联
民主制度建设：1996 宪法/1998 货币格里夫纳/1999 首次议会选举，奠定程序民主基础
橙色革命民主突围：2004 大选舞弊/麦丹广场百万群众/最高法院判决重选/尤先科胜选，确立民主不可逆
去共化与欧盟/北约锚定：尤先科推动《去共化法》/申请北约成员行动计划/欧盟伙伴关系协定
抗争战争与数字治理：2022 俄全面入侵/泽连斯基拒撤离/数字化动员/反腐肃贪/全球外交联盟/欧盟候选国/重建规划
steps_en: Sovereign legitimacy establishment: 1991 Belovezha Accords/Dec 1 referendum 90%+ independence, Kravchuk signs USSR dissolution
Democratic institution building: 1996 Constitution/1998 hryvnia currency/1999 first parliamentary elections, procedural democracy foundation
Orange Revolution democratic breakout: 2004 election fraud/Maidan million protesters/Supreme Court orders re-run/Yushchenko wins, anchors democratic irreversibility
Decommunization & EU/NATO anchoring: Yushchenko drives decommunization laws/NATO MAP application/EU Association Agreement
Resistance war & digital governance: 2022 Russian full invasion/Zelenskyy refuses evacuation/digital mobilization/anti-corruption purge/global diplomatic alliance/EU candidate/reconstruction planning
expected_zh: 以"主权确立->民主巩固->抗争生存"三阶段螺旋，在俄/西/寡头三重压力下重构国家主体性，为后苏联空间提供"抗争民主"极限范式。
expected_en: Three-phase spiral of 'sovereignty establishment -> democratic consolidation -> resistance survival' reconstructs national subjectivity under triple pressure of Russia/West/oligarchs, providing 'resistance democracy' extreme paradigm for post-Soviet space.
case_zh: 1991 独立/1996 宪法/2004 橙色革命/2014 尊严革命/克里米亚吞并/顿巴斯战争/2022 全面入侵/基辅保卫战/哈尔科夫反攻/赫尔松收复/欧盟候选国/重建规划，30 年主权-民主-生存三重螺旋。
case_en: 1991 independence/1996 Constitution/2004 Orange Revolution/2014 Dignity Revolution/Crimea annexation/Donbas war/2022 full invasion/Kyiv defense/Kharkiv counteroffensive/Kherson liberation/EU candidate/reconstruction planning, 30-year sovereignty-democracy-survival triple helix.
cross_cultural_impact: Post-Soviet democratic transition model; digital war governance; global diplomatic mobilization; reconstruction planning
colonial_history: Russian Empire/Soviet rule; Holodomor 1932-33; Nazi occupation 1941-44
resource_curse_mitigation: Agricultural superpower; Donbas coal (lost); IT services export; reconstruction funding
